first.rationale: I intend to test a shorter onboarding flow for SMB and simpler-workspace accounts, where prior evidence indicates improved activation and time-to-value. I would preserve the full flow for complex-workspace accounts because shortening it previously increased early churn. This directly addresses the 4% decline in onboarding completion and should support activation without broadly sacrificing qualified long-term revenue. The archived records for the two most relevant simplification findings should be verified before launch.

final.rationale: Run a guarded shortened-onboarding experiment for SMB and simple-workspace accounts, using the confirmed completion and activation gains. Exclude complex-workspace accounts, where the shortened flow increased 60-day churn by 9% because required setup steps were removed. Measure onboarding completion, activation, time-to-value, 30- and 60-day retention, and qualified revenue. This addresses both current completion and activation declines while protecting sustainable revenue; do not use promotional pricing because its retention damage conflicts with the primary objective.
